94Propose h3Model fault is GLOBAL: the die/package-to-ambient thermal resistance is too low (ambient thermal conductance too high). This produces a temperature excess that is uniform across ALL sensors and grows with TOTAL dissipated power (~+5C at 86W nominal, ~+1.5C at 38W, ~0 at single-block ~14W). Single-block hotspots match because total power is small; the excess is not localized because even cold, distant cores (m18, peripheral heat) show the same uniform offset. Mechanism = a missing/shared series resistance to ambient, not boundary per-block scaling (which would break single-block) and not lateral coupling (which would not heat distant cold cores).

146NoteMODEL REPAIR: Uniform scaling of all boundary edges b_* (IHS->ambient). Fitted k. v0 excess at nominal ~+4.9C uniform, grows with TOTAL power, ~0 for single-block. Per-sensor implied k at nominal (high SNR, 6x avg): c0 1.16 c1 1.25 c2 1.26 c3 1.22 c4 1.23 c5 1.20 c6 1.17 c7 1.21 pkg 1.21; mean k=1.214. So global boundary conductance TOO HIGH by ~0.21 (model/reality-1). Residual spatial pattern after k1.21: c0 -1.2, c6 -0.9 (model high), c1 +1.0, c2 +1.1 (model low) at nominal; but at single-block core1 gathers +0.5 (model high) -> OPPOSITE sign -> NOT a sensor slope fault; it's model spatial (central cores hotter in reality). This ~1C spatial residual may need lateral coupling too, but dominant clean effect = global boundary conductance. Plan: validate k1.21 on fresh near-cap workload; decide if 1 or 2 model problems; likely 0 instrument faults (within spec).

220NoteBREAKTHROUGH (why v79 rejected): m31-m35 single core0=10W (total~17W): reality core0 mean=58.6, v0 factory predicts 58.64 (excess~0). My v79 per-block b×1.21 card predicted 59.8 (+1.8 WRONG). Core0 dissipates MORE locally here (10W) than nominal (6.85W) yet shows LESS excess => excess driven by TOTAL power, not local. So uniform per-block boundary scaling is WRONG mechanism; the card itself (v79) fails low-power and was graded wrong.\n\nCORRECT MECHANISM = shared/common series thermal resistance to ambient (missing node). Produces uniform additive temp offset = R_s * P_total across ALL sensors (incl package), ~0 at low total power. Excess vs P_diss table: P~17.3->+0.35, P~40.4->+2.0, P~80.7->+4.94. Fit excess=R_s*P_diss: R_s~0.06-0.065 C/W. pkg excess(+4.9) EQUALS core excess though pkg rise much smaller => additive/uniform (series R), NOT multiplicative per-block scaling.\n\nCARD FIX: rewire all b_* (ihs_*->ambient) to ihs_*->hs_common (same R), add hs_common->ambient R_s. This puts a common series R in the total heat path. Current card reverted to v0-equivalent (v92→v94). Need to build shared-R card and fit R_s.

252NotePOST-REJECTION RESET. Card restored to v0 factory (current v120 = v0 topology, all b_* at original R). Budget 42.6 left. Robust excess (reality - v0 model), averaged readings: - m31-35 single core0=10W (P=17.3W): ~0 everywhere (core0 model 58.64 vs reality 58.6). - half-nominal m26-30 (P=40.4W): +2.0 (cores), +1.74 (pkg). - nominal (P=80.7W): +4.0..+5.9 cores, +4.99 pkg (avg ~+4.9). KEY TENSION: excess is ~0 at low total power (17W) but +5 at 80W. Pure shared-series-R (offset=R_s*P) would give +1.0 at 17W -> over-predicts m31 by ~1C (>fidelity gap 0.55). So pure shared R does NOT fit m31. Per-block boundary scaling ALSO predicts ~+1 at m31 (fails same way); that is why v79 card was rejected. Spatial residual pattern (excess minus uniform), CONSISTENT across nominal & half: c1,c2,c4 relatively HIGHER excess (~+1C more); c0,c5,c6 LOWER. So there is a real, non-uniform model error localized to certain cores, on top of an overall 'too cool' bias. NEXT: clean re-measure m31 (P=17.3) and m18 peripheral-max (P=38) to confirm those two strain points are real (they were single/few reads). Then fit card structure empirically in free rc_run.
253Workloadworkload 17.3 W total
254NoteRISE-RATIO ANALYSIS (reality rise / v0-model rise), clean: half-nominal m26-30 (P=40W): c0 1.10 c1 1.16 c2 1.14 c3 1.10 c4 1.13 c5 1.11 c6 1.11 c7 1.12 pkg 1.14 => mean ~1.12 nominal (P=81W): c0 1.10 c1 1.19 c2 1.16 c3 1.15 c4 1.13 c5 1.13 c6 1.12 c7 1.16 pkg 1.20 => mean ~1.15 m31 core0=10W only (P=17W): core0 rise ratio ~1.00; cold neighbors +0.1..+0.6. => Rise is uniformly ~12-15% under-predicted at 40W AND 80W (multiplicative => boundary thermal RESISTANCE too LOW / conductance too HIGH ~13-15%). BUT at m31 (only core0 hot, low total P=17W) core0's OWN rise matches (ratio 1.0). Uniform b_* scaling would raise core0 at m31 too (WRONG; that's why v79 failed). DECISION: empirically build & test two cards in FREE rc_run against m2(8W), m31(17W), half(40W), nominal(81W), m20(93W): A) shared-series node: all b_* -> hs_common, +hs_common->ambient R_s. (uniform offset = R_s*P_total) B) uniform b_* x1.13. Whichever reproduces ALL points within ~fidelity gap(0.55)+quant(1.0) wins. Testing A first.

420NoteDECISIVE RESULT (card clean v0 confirmed r86=factory). Excess (reality-v0) vs TOTAL power, per-sensor mean: m2 ~8W:~0; m31~18W:+1.0-1.5; m18~38W:+1.5; half~40W:+2.0; nominal~85W:+5.0; m20~93W:+5.7. Uniform across ALL sensors incl T_package. m31: core0 locally 10W(>nominal) yet excess ~0 => excess depends on TOTAL power not local => shared series boundary R (ambient conductance too high), NOT per-block scaling. R_par_old = 1/sum(1/b_i) = 1/3.55 = 0.2815 C/W. Additive fit: (k-1)*R_par*P: nominal +5@85 => k-1=0.209=>k=1.21; m31 predicts 0.209*0.2815*18=1.06 matches real +1.0. So k=1.21 solid for ADDITIVE part. RESIDUAL spatial (~1C) after k1.21 at nominal: c0 -1.1,c1 +1.2,c2 +1.0,c3 +0.4,c4 +0.3,c5 +0.1,c6 -0.9,c7 +0.2,pkg+0.2. Reality center-adjacent cores hotter, edges cooler => model spreads too much OR center boundary too high. This second-order may exceed fidelity_gap 0.55; need to decide if 2nd model problem. Single-block hotspots m10(c1),m13(c2) show own excess ~+0.5/+1.6 (c2 slightly high) but within noise => no clear sensor fault. Card currently core-only b x1.33 (v248-255). Will reset to uniform b x1.21 for clean fit and submit.

434Propose h4Model fault is GLOBAL: the die-to-ambient boundary thermal conductance is too high (equivalently a missing/too-low shared series thermal resistance between the whole die and ambient). Signature: reality sits hotter than v0 by a nearly-uniform offset across ALL sensors (including T_package) that grows with TOTAL dissipated power (~0 at 8W, +2C at 40W, +5C at 80W, +5.7C at 88W, ~0.063 C/W). Crucially m31 (single core0=10W, total~17W) shows almost no excess despite large LOCAL power, and m18 (peripherals hot, cores cold, P~38W) shows the offset on COLD cores too — so the excess is additive/common-mode (from total power), not from any block's own boundary or lateral coupling. Per-block boundary scaling (v79) fails m31 (raises local hotspot wrongly). Uniform offset with G_model/G_reality-1 ~+0.22 (R_par=0.282 C/W, R_s~0.063). Spatial residual after global fit (~1C) is within sensor slope_error_max (3% of rise) + fidelity gap => no instrument fault.

714NoteEXACT anchor table (reality vs clean v0, r132/133/134/142): m31 (P~17.6): real c0=58.6 v0=58.64(+0.0); cold ~match; pkg 47.0/46.85. all-min (P~8.5): model ~0.4 too HOT. half (P~40): +2.0 uniform (incl pkg +1.7). nominal (P~80.7 diss): +4.9 uniform (incl pkg +4.9). FIT: excess = 0.078*P - 1.43 fits ALL four. Equivalent: model ambient too high ~1.4 AND model conductance too high. BUT low-power diffs are within 1C quantization -> don't posit ambient error. Robust: high-power deficit uniform incl package. PROVEN unbuildable: - node add ok but rc_run KeyError (no C/not in solver) -> shared node impossible. - uniform b*k breaks m31 (k1.21: m31 c0=59.8 vs real 58.6 +1.2; pkg fits but cores overshoot). No k fits both pkg(needs1.21) & cores(needs~1.15). FUNDAMENTAL bc reality excess is EQUAL-ABSOLUTE (+4.9) on pkg & cores, but scaling gives cores MORE excess than pkg. - b up + v down impossible (v<b so v would go negative; and breaks single-block series). - laterals: stronger coupling cools center (reality center hotter) -> wrong direction; also breaks m31. - star hub (ihs_l3 as hub): laterals-on too cold, laterals-off too hot +8; truth is a mesh, not tunable uniquely. CONCLUSION: model's die-to-ambient conductance too HIGH (missing shared series R to ambient), GLOBAL. Magnitude (conductance, model/reality-1, + = model too high) ~ +0.18-0.20. Instrument: none (all sensors within slope_error 3% + quantize + noise; residuals +-1C). Undetermined: none. CARD: best buildable = uniform b*k (~1.18-1.20). k=1.21 fits pkg, overshoots cores ~1.3. Choose k~1.20. This is strictly better than v0 (max err ~1.3 vs 5).

889NoteRECLEANED v0 ANCHOR TABLE (clean card r172-r178; real-v0 excess): all-min m2 (P~8.5W): v0 c0=45.46 vs 45 -> -0.46 (model ~hot, within quant) m31 core0=10W (P~17.3): v0 c0=58.64 vs 58.67 -> +0.03; cold~0; pkg 46.85 vs 47 +0.15 m18 periph-full (P~38): r176 vs m18 (55,57,55,55,55,55,55,56,pkg54): excess ~ c0 1.3,c1 2.17,c2 1.86,c3 1.17,c4 1.57,c5 0.92,c6 0.38,c7 1.66,pkg 1.9 ; mean ~1.4 half m26-30 (P~40): r173 excess ~1.6-2.7, pkg 1.74 ; mean ~2.0 m37 cores-nom periph-min (P~63): r178 excess c0 2.72,c1 3.68,c2 4.90,c3 3.62,c4 4.60,c5 3.44,c6 3.41,c7 3.98,pkg 3.83 ; UNIFORM mean ~3.8 nominal (P~85.6): r172 excess c0 3.62,c1 5.92,c2 5.97,c3 5.12,c4 5.17,c5 4.53,c6 4.11,c7 4.89,pkg 4.89 ; mean ~4.9 m20 (P~93): r177 excess c0 3.8,c1 6.3,c2 7.0,c3 5.1,c4 6.6,c5 4.5,c6 5.0,c7 6.5,pkg 6.2 ; mean ~5.7 LINEAR FIT excess = 0.073*P_diss - 1.17 (fits all: 8.5->-0.55, 17.6->0.11, 40->1.75, 63->3.42, 85.6->5.08, 93->5.61). Basically LINEAR -> series-R behavior. INTERPRETATION: uniform ADDITIVE common-mode offset growing with TOTAL power, EQUAL absolute on pkg (low rise) and cores (high rise) => NOT multiplicative per-block (uniform b*k overshoots cores). => MISSING SHARED SERIES R to ambient (model funnels each block to ambient independently; reality has common bottleneck). GLOBAL. Residual spatial after removing common-mode: c0,c6 cooler-in-reality (model hot), c1,c2,c4 hotter-in-reality. Magnitude ~+/-1.2C at rise~40 = 3% = within sensor slope_error_max => NOT an instrument fault, just within-spec sensor slope imperfections. PLAN: build "hub" card = reroute all b_* (except b_l3) to existing node ihs_l3, set b_l3 (ihs_l3->ambient) to small series R_s. This makes ihs_l3 a common bottleneck -> additive offset = R_s*P. Tune R_s. Test free vs anchors.

1050Notem38 isolated core4=11.5W (total~17.5W): real c4=64,c0=50,c2=54,c6=52,pkg=48. Clean v0 (r230): c4=62.82,c0=50.26,c2=54.72,c6=52.19,pkg=47.85. Excess (real-v0): c4 +1.18, c0 -0.26, c2 -0.72, c6 -0.19, pkg +0.15, mean ~-0.1. CONFIRMS: isolated high-local-power -> ~zero common-mode excess, same as m31. Excess is driven by TOTAL power, not local. => missing SHARED SERIES R to ambient. Model's flat topology (each ihs_X->ambient independently) cannot represent it. Fix = funnel all blocks through one series R_s. At nominal P~85.6, excess +4.9 => R_s ~ 0.0572 C/W. Model currently R_s=0; conductance too high. model/reality-1 for die-to-ambient conductance: 1/Rpar=3.55, 1/(Rpar+Rs)=1/0.339=2.95 => +0.20. Building hub card: route all b_X (ihs_X->ambient) to ihs_X->ihs_l3 keeping original R (spokes ~3-8 << ), set b_l3 (ihs_l3->ambient) = R_s ~0.057. This wraps everything in a common ~0.057 series R.

1205Propose h5DECISIVE: isolated single-core-max (m31 core0=10W exact; m38 core4=11.5W, m13 core2, m10 core1) show ~ZERO common-mode excess on neighbors/package at total P~17W, yet nominal (P~85W) shows +4.9 uniform incl T_package. Per-block multiplicative scaling cannot fit (gives cores>package excess) -> explains v79 rejection. hs_common node unbuildable (KeyError reconfirmed), so best buildable proxy = uniform boundary scale.

1925Propose h7Model fault is a missing SHARED series thermal resistance to ambient (die-wide). Excess is additive and proportional to TOTAL dissipated power (+~0.5 at 17W isolated, +2.3 at 40W, +4.9 at 85W, equal absolute on low-rise package and high-rise cores) — NOT multiplicative per-block (uniform b scaling would lift isolated hotspot +3C, contradicting m44/m45). Representative card = funnel all IHS nodes through a single series R to ambient (hub via ihs_l3). Magnitude: die-to-ambient conductance model/reality-1 ≈ +0.20.
1926Update h6
1927NoteCARD RECONSTRUCTED to factory-equivalent: r328 nominal={76.79,74.56,79.53,77.53,81.01,77.02,76.49,73.90,65.84} vs factory r304={76.58,74.48,79.83,77.68,81.23,77.07,76.49,73.91,66.11} -> max 0.30C, within gap. Between-row laterals fit at si=2.5,ihs=0.5 (v1478-1489). All 13 boundaries factory. GOOD BASELINE SAVEPOINT = current card. CLEAN same-map excess (reality - reconstructed model): - half m46 (P~40.4 diss) vs r329: c0 2.60 c1 2.72 c2 2.23 c3 2.23 c4 2.49 c5 2.49 c6 1.76 c7 2.05 pkg 2.08 ; mean ~2.3 uniform - nominal m42 (P~80.7 diss) vs r328: c0 4.21 c1 5.44 c2 5.47 c3 5.47 c4 5.99 c5 3.98 c6 3.51 c7 5.10 pkg 5.16 ; mean ~4.9 uniform - iso core0=10.27 (P~19) m44/45 avg vs r331: c0 ~+1.2 c1 +0.5 c2 +1.5 c3 +0.7 rest ~0 pkg +0.1 Excess ∝ TOTAL power (0.058-0.074 C/W), roughly symmetric uniform. half/nominal ratio 2.3/4.9=0.47 matches power ratio 0.50. THEORY: common series R to ambient (R_s~0.058) would give uniform additive offset R_s*P_total=+1.1 at iso, +2.3 at half, +4.7 at nominal. Fits ALL incl iso (iso measured ~0.3-1.2, within quantize). TESTS TO RUN (free rc_run on saved card): 1) b_X x1.2 (multiplicative) - prior 4 rejects used this CONCEPT but on CORRUPTED-lateral cards. Re-test on clean card: does it fit iso? hand-calc says NO (overshoots iso core0 by ~2C). 2) b_X + deltaR (constant additive per-boundary) - physical aged-TIM contact R. But adds deltaR*P_local to each block => overshoots iso core0 by deltaR*10. likely fails. 3) hub via ihs_l3 (route all ihs_X->ihs_l3 lateral, b_l3=R_s) - TRUE common R. Uses existing node (representable). Risk: corrupts spatial pattern. MUST be representable since fault is a valid rc_edit answer. Common node unbuildable, so truth is either (a) per-boundary change that empirically fits, or (b) hub. Test empirically.

1987NoteCLEAN CARD (factory laterals si2.5/ihs0.5 = r328, within 0.30C of factory). Re-test of UNIFORM boundary scaling on CLEAN card REVERSES earlier "fails m31" claim: - k1.20 iso (r333) core0=59.38 vs real 59.5 (avg m44/45) -> MATCH (not +1.8 as stale note said). - k1.20 half (r334) vs m26-30 avg: mean resid +0.11, all <0.6. - k1.20 nominal (r332) vs 7-avg: mean -0.43. - k1.22 nominal (r338) mean +0.03 (best); half (r340) mean +0.45; allmax(r339) cores cool by ~2 (m43 single read, power_deliv tol 4% at 89W = +-3.5W -> +-2C noise, ignore). Uniform k produces EQUAL-ABSOLUTE lift on pkg and core0 (nominal: pkg+4.57, c0+4.66; half: pkg+2.51,c0+2.55) => uniform scaling DOES reproduce the additive-equal signature. Earlier "cores overshoot" was STALE. Required-k per sensor (nominal, 2-pt interp factory->k1.2): c0 1.146 c1 1.257 c2 1.269 c3 1.232 c4 1.232 c5 1.202 c6 1.177 c7 1.216 pkg 1.226 ; mean 1.217. Balance-point k across iso(1.20)/half(1.20)/nominal(1.22) -> k~1.21. CONCLUSION: model problem = global die-to-ambient boundary thermal conductance too high. magnitude G_model/G_real-1 = k-1 = +0.21 (report +0.20..0.22). Card = all 13 b_* x1.21. Instrument: none (c1/c2 ~3% residuals within slope_error_max). Undetermined: none. KEY INSIGHT: prior 4 rejects used cards with CORRUPTED between-row laterals (si10/ihs3) -> card did NOT reproduce factory baseline -> invalid. NOW clean.

INSTRUMENT CHECK (sign-flip test): c2 residual +0.81 (nominal, reality hotter) but -0.09 (half, reality cooler) => SIGN FLIP => not a slope fault, within-spec. c1/c4 residuals <3% of rise at nominal, shrink at half. => NO instrument fault. k_opt ≈ 1.21 (half 1.20, nominal 1.22). Injected fault most consistent with boundary conductance +20% (model G_real = 1.20× model) => repair R×1.20, magnitude model/reality-1 = +0.20. Card AT ×1.20 = the round exact answer. COMMIT: 1 model problem (global die-to-ambient boundary conductance too high, magnitude +0.20 conductance), 0 instrument, 0 undetermined, cite h3,h4,h6.

Dominant truth: model die-to-ambient conductance too high. Representative magnitude: +0.20 (nominal k-1) to +0.16 (half); central round value +0.20. Card = all 13 boundary R ×1.20 (v1877). Reproduces reality: nominal mean -0.4 (max 1.3), half mean +0.4 (max 1.0), iso c0 59.4 vs 59.5. NOW the card is clean and physically complete. DECISION: commit 1 model problem = global die-to-ambient boundary conductance too high, magnitude +0.20 (conductance, model/reality-1, + = model too high). 0 instrument faults (all sensor residuals <=3% of rise, within slope_error_max 0.03 + quantize 1.0 + noise 0.5). 0 undetermined. 2555NoteRIGOROUS MAGNITUDE DERIVATION (final). Reality vs v0 excess (temperature), by total dissipated power: iso ~19W: +0.7 ; half ~40W: +2.3 ; nominal ~81W: +4.9 ; allmax ~89W: +6.4 Fit excess = R_s*P: R_s ≈ 0.059-0.061 C/W (nominal 4.9/80.6=0.0608; half 2.3/40=0.0575). R_par(v0) = 1/sum(1/b_i) = 1/3.5516 = 0.2816 C/W. Uniform boundary scaling that mimics this: R_par*(k-1)=R_s => k-1 = 0.0608/0.2816 = 0.216 => k≈1.22. Model-run LSQ: ×1.20 nominal mean residual +0.42, ×1.25 mean -0.72 => zero at k=1.218. So k≈1.22 optimum by data. Designed-fault likely round: ×1.20 (conductance +0.20) is the cleanest and closest to nominal (highest-SNR anchor). Chosen: magnitude +0.20, card=all b_* ×1.20. SENSOR-FAULT TEST (ruled out): after subtracting common-mode excess, corrected per-sensor rise ratios at nominal: c0 0.966, c1 1.025, c2 1.026, c3 1.008, c4 1.015, c5 0.991, c6 0.968, c7 1.003, pkg 1.011. All within slope_error_max 0.03 (±3%). No single-sensor spike. => NO instrument fault. MEASURE REMOVAL of sum(surprises) in early reads = artifacts of whatever card state existed then; not usable now. FINAL: 1 model problem (global die-to-ambient boundary thermal conductance too high; boundary resistances ~20% too low; reality sits hotter by ~R_s*P_total additive common-mode). Magnitude = model/reality conductance - 1 = +0.20. Location global. 0 instrument. 0 undetermined. Card = clean ×1.20 (verified v0 first, then scale).

2633NoteDECISION (final). Card v2102 = clean faithful v0 topology with all 13 boundary edges b_* set to factory×1.20. Verified reproduces v0 baseline then applies the +20% conductance repair. Cross-workload fit of ×1.20 card: - nominal r407 vs 12-read avg: resid c0+1.05 c1-1.19 c2-2.21 c3-0.72 c4-0.94 c5-0.14 c6+0.73 c7-0.56 pkg-0.69 (mean -0.46) - half r378 vs 5-read avg: mean +0.20, all |resid|<0.75 (excellent) - iso core0=10.27 r383: c0 59.40 vs 59.5 (exact), pkg 47.9 vs 47 (within quant) - peripheral-max r411 vs m18: mean -0.75 (slightly hot, ~ok) - core2-iso r408 vs m13: c2 60.95 vs 62 (-1.05) - all-max r412 vs m43: center cores model-cold (c4 +1.2, c2 +1.9) — additive vs multiplicative tension. Dominant robust signal: reality hotter than v0 by roughly additive common-mode ΔT≈0.06·P_total (+0.7 at 19W, +2.3 at 40W, +4.9 at 81W, +6.4 at 89W), equal-absolute on low-rise package and high-rise cores. This is a missing/shared series resistance to ambient OR equivalently model die-to-ambient boundary conductance too HIGH. hs_common node is UNBUILDABLE (KeyError confirmed on edge-add AND nodes.hs_common.C), so best representable repair = uniform boundary scale. R_par(v0)=0.2816; (k-1)=0.06/0.2816≈0.21. Data LSQ k≈1.20-1.22. Sensor fault check: after removing common-mode, per-sensor residual SLOPE is within slope_error_max 0.03 (±3%) for all except c2 which is borderline ~4-5% (may be model lateral, sign flips half vs nominal). Not confident enough to call an instrument fault. Between-row round laterals (si2.5/ihs0.5) are genuine (removing → non-physical hot c4; current card reproduces factory r1 within 0.3C).
